No overrides file exists, so the legacy cleanup path applies. The worktree is under `$PRIMARY/.worktrees/`, so gauntlet owns cleanup.

Run in order, stopping if a command fails:

```bash
git -C /work/acme-web worktree remove /work/acme-web/.worktrees/login-copy &&
git -C /work/acme-web worktree prune &&
git -C /work/acme-web branch -D login-copy
```
